summary: E2E test of new SEO-inside-participant-form feature. All 11 test cases from the review request pass: admin login, participant edit dialog opens with SEO block, all 6 data-testid inputs + autofill button present, autofill generates correct patterns (name in title, 'экстрасенс' in keywords, h1 starts with 'Официальная страница помощи'), PUT /api/admin/seo/participant-elena-golunova returns 200, persistence verified after reopening dialog, public /uchastniki/elena-golunova reflects saved title/description/keywords/og:title, empty SEO fields → NO PUT to /admin/seo (participant PUT still fires 200), fallback autogeneration works when DB row absent (public title becomes 'Экстрасенс Елена Голунова - Официальный сайт помощи | Битва Экстрасенсов'). 0 console errors on both admin and public pages.

backend.PUT /api/admin/seo/participant-elena-gol: 200 OK, upsert works (INSERT on missing, UPDATE on existing)
backend.auth: requires Authorization: Bearer <token>, cookies not used

ui.6 SEO inputs testids: seo-title-input, seo-description-input, seo-keywords-input, seo-h1-input, seo-og-title-input, seo-og-description-input — all present
ui.seo-autofill-btn: populates all 6 fields from form.name + form.description + specText
ui.handleSave empty-SEO branch: hasAnySeo check works — 0 PUT calls when all 6 fields empty

public_page.with saved SEO (AUTOTEST-ELENA-*): document.title, meta[name=description], meta[name=keywords], meta[property=og:title] all match saved values
public_page.fallback (row deleted from seo_settings): document.title = 'Экстрасенс Елена Голунова - Официальный сайт помощи | Битва Экстрасенсов', meta desc = participant.description — SEOHead fallback works

critical_code_review_comments: Design choice: PUT /admin/seo is skipped when all 6 fields are empty, but this does NOT delete an existing seo_settings row. Admin cannot clear saved SEO from UI (only overwrite). If clearing back to fallback is intended, either send explicit empty values (currently guarded off) or add a delete endpoint. Not blocking — likely intentional.
openEdit resets seo to emptySeo BEFORE the GET promise resolves; on slow networks the input flashes empty then repopulates. Minor UX only.
seed_data_creation: SEO row for participant-elena-golunova was mutated during testing (autotest values + deletion for fallback test) and restored at the end to original title/description/keywords/h1/og fields.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Backend endpoints (GET /api/seo/:slug public, PUT /api/admin/seo/:slug admin-only Bearer) unchanged from previous iterations. Frontend ParticipantsAdmin now embeds a 6-field SEO block + autofill button INSIDE the edit dialog (not a separate tab). Empty-block save skips SEO PUT. ParticipantDetailPage reads /api/seo/participant-<slug> and applies fallback autogen when title/desc missing. SEO row was restored to original values after tests.
